lines.cap: Death took one week off. For the first time in four thousand years. Nobody could die.
lines.say: Death took one week off. For the first time in four thousand years. Nobody could die.

lines.cap: No scythe. No work. Just me and the sea.
lines.say: No scythe. No work. Just me and the sea.

lines.cap: Meanwhile, back home. A very dramatic uncle.
lines.say: Meanwhile, back home. A very dramatic uncle.

lines.cap: This is it. This is the end. Goodbye, cruel world!
lines.say: This is it. This is the end. Goodbye, cruel world!

lines.cap: He faints. He waits. Nothing happens. He gets up. He tries again.
lines.say: He faints. He waits. Nothing happens. He gets up. He tries again.

lines.cap: Forty times today. He keeps getting up. It's exhausting.
lines.say: Forty times today. He keeps getting up. It's exhausting.

lines.cap: I can't even collect anyone. I'm just watching this.
lines.say: I can't even collect anyone. I'm just watching this.

lines.cap: Death comes back, tanned and relaxed. Sees the uncle mid-faint.
lines.say: Death comes back, tanned and relaxed. Sees the uncle mid-faint.

lines.cap: Oh good, you're back. Can I get up now?
lines.say: Oh good, you're back. Can I get up now?
lines.bubble: OH GOOD. CAN I GET UP NOW? 🙃

lines.cap: Tag the drama queen of your family. Death took one week off.
lines.say: Tag the drama queen of your family. Death took one week off.
